mapper.select: SELECT oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, oi.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, img.IMAGE_NO AS imageNo, revImg.REVIEW_IMAGE_NO AS reviewImageNo, oi.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDERED_AT AS orderedAt FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN OFT_REVIEW r ON r.ORDER_ITEM_NO = oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MIN(IMAGE_NO) AS IMAGE_NO FROM OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE IS_MAIN = 'Y' GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) img ON img.PRODUCT_NO = oi.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REVIEW_NO, MIN(REVIEW_IMAGE_NO) AS REVIEW_IMAGE_NO FROM OFT_REVIEW_IMAGE GROUP BY REVIEW_NO ) revImg ON revImg.REVIEW_NO = r.REVIEW_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{_parameter} AND NVL(d.DELIVERY_STATUS, 'READY') = 'DELIVERED' AND r.REVIEW_NO IS NULL ORDER BY o.ORDERED_AT DESC, oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO DESC

SELECT r.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, r.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, r.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, img.IMAGE_NO AS imageNo, revImg.REVIEW_IMAGE_NO AS reviewImageNo, oi.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, r.RATING AS rating, r.CONTENT AS content, o.ORDERED_AT AS orderedAt, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM OFT_REVIEW r JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO = r.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND oi.PRODUCT_NO = r.PRODUCT_NO JOIN OFT_ORDERS o ON o.ORDER_NO = oi.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MIN(IMAGE_NO) AS IMAGE_NO FROM OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE IS_MAIN = 'Y' GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) img ON img.PRODUCT_NO = r.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REVIEW_NO, MIN(REVIEW_IMAGE_NO) AS REVIEW_IMAGE_NO FROM OFT_REVIEW_IMAGE GROUP BY REVIEW_NO ) revImg ON revImg.REVIEW_NO = r.REVIEW_NO WHERE r.USER_NO = #{_parameter} AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.REVIEW_NO DESC
